Class CsvUtils.CsvHeaders

public class CsvUtils.CsvHeaders
extends CsvUtils.CsvGenericLine

Manages CSV column headers with case-insensitive lookup by name. Extends CsvGenericLine to store header values and maintain a name-to-index mapping for named field access.
